approval.direction: User selected the second response/ledger preview.
approval.latest_correction: Portrait and dialogue box must have exactly the same height and aligned top/bottom edges.
approval.scene_status: Composition and colours accepted as a guide; carpet markings need simplification. Room image is not a final camera-matched backdrop.

layout.coordinate_format: x, y, width, height; all values are logical pixels at 1920x1080
layout.alignment: same top 720 and bottom 1020, including name ribbon and ornaments
layout.portrait_note: Place the live SubViewport behind the frame. Its curved aperture needs masking or clipping; keep face and moving jaw inside the safe rectangle. A background backing colour is rendered separately, never baked into portrait_frame.png.
layout.sizing_rule: Long text and wrapped choices scroll. Content must never enlarge either outer frame. Use the supplied atlas regions, not full PNG canvases, to eliminate unequal transparent padding.
layout.responsive_rule: Scale the logical canvas uniformly or adapt both containers together; never change one frame height alone.
layout.portrait_live_viewport_note: A larger live viewport may fill the curved aperture if clipped/masked to it; keep eyes, mouth and moving chin inside the 212x212 safe square.

typography.note: These are actual supplied fonts for live engine text. AI mockup lettering is illustrative and does not embed these font files.

speech.label: speaker name
speech.auto_follow: Only while the reader is already at the bottom. Preserve manual scroll-back.
speech.continue: First activation finishes typewriter reveal; next advances. Scroll actions are never advance actions.

responses.portrait: responding player character as shown in the selected concept
responses.label: localised Your response
responses.wrapped_rows: Grow to fit text; fewer rows are visible when wrapping. Panel remains 300px high.
responses.focus: Selected background plus brass outline and chevron; keep live numbers.
responses.activation: Mouse click or explicit confirm action, not scroll wheel or focus navigation.

dialogue_frame.background: true alpha transparency outside the shape

nine_slice.godot_method: A fixed-size unscaled Control host owns the visual NinePatchRect child. Use the atlas region as NinePatchRect.region_rect, child scale (texture_scale, texture_scale), local child size target_size / texture_scale, and patch margins in source pixels. The visual child must not be a direct child of a Container. Keep live text and hit targets in the unscaled host.
